newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 52,000 MT were off 17 percent from the previous week and 52 percent from the 4-week average. Major increases for Egypt (31,000 MT, all destination changes) Italy (26,800 MT, all destination changes), Israel (25,000 MT, all destination changes), Venezuela (21,100 MT), Croatia (18,200 MT), and Japan (15,100 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (105,100 MT) and China (48,000 MT, includes 5,000 new sales and 53,000 cancellations).

Exports of 296,200 MT--a marketing-year high--were two and four-fifths times the previous week and 94 percent more than 4-week average. Thailand (53,800 MT), China (38,700 MT), Italy (27,400 MT), Venezuela (20,100 MT), and Croatia (18,200 MT) were the major recipients.
